div.p:
PROVIDES A SIMPLIFIED INTERFACE TO A COMPLEX SUBSYSTEM, HIDING ITS
INTERNAL STRUCTURE BEHIND A STABLE PUBLIC INTERFACE. USED HERE TO
KEEP THE LLM/TOOL INTERNALS OF THE PANTRYPAL AGENT LOOP BEHIND A
SINGLE INVOKE ENTRY POINT.

APPLIES TO: PRESSW/PANTRYPAL_PLAN.D2 —
CORE.AGENT_LOOP WRAPS EXTERNAL.LLM_PROVIDER, TOOLS.TOOL_SEARCH,
AND TOOLS.TOOL_EQUIPMENT BEHIND A SINGLE INVOKE CALL FROM
API_CHAT; CALLERS SHOULD ONLY EVER REFERENCE AGENT_LOOP, NOT ITS
INTERNALS.

MY-CHESS/SEQ_CONNECTOR.D2 — THE
FASTAPI ENDPOINT ROUTER HIDES PYTHON-CHESS, NETWORKX, AND THE
DIAGON CLI BEHIND TWO HTTP ROUTES.
